violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the 1DR upright, pasta cooler: heavy cream (54f), spinach and ricotta ravioli (50f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CHEF DISCARDED THE AFOREMENTIONED FOODS. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION. ENFORCEMENT MAY BE WARRANTED IF THIS CONTINUES.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw beef shanks were being stored over cooked risotto rice
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CHEF MOVED THE RAW BEEF CONTAINER ON TOP OF A BOX OF RAW CHICKEN. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Observed an unlabeled squeeze bottle containing clear yellow liquid being stored by the dishwashing area.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CHEF LABELED THE SQUEEZE BOTTLE AS BLEACH. PLEASE LABEL ALL CHEMICAL BOTTLES.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed raw eggs and raw veal being stored above whole produce and prepared foods in the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO MOVE THE RAW ANIMAL PROTEINS TO THE LOWER SHELVES. STORE ALL POULTRY ON THE BOTTOM. GROUNDS MEATS SHALL BE ABOVE POULTRY. WHOLE SEAFOOD, BEEF, PORK, VEAL, LAMB, AND SHELLED EGGS SHALL BE STORED ABOVE GROUND MEATS. violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) tomato sauce (132f); 2) chicken stock (131f); and brown sauce (131f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC PULLED EVERYTHING FROM THE STEAM WELL AND REHEATED IT ON THE STOVE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed several large containers of soups and sauces in the walk in refrigerator being held for more than 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO DISCARD ALL OF THE EXPIRED FOOD.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed pans of raw chicken, raw lamb, and raw shell stock being stored on the floor of the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC MOVED ALL THE RAW FOODS TO A SHELF.

violations.title: Linens & Napkins, Proper Use
violations.observation: Observed cloths being used to separate raw shell stock and ice in the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Linens may not be used in contact with food unless they are used to line a container for the service of foods and the linens are replaced each time the container is refilled for a new consumer. PIC REMOVED ALL CLOTHS FROM THE RAW SHELL STOCK CONTAINER.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed a container full of water and in-use utensils on the steam table. The water in the container was observed at 132f.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED ALL THE CONTAINER FROM THE STEAM TABLE. IN-USE UTENSILS CAN BE STORED IN WATER THAT IS 135f OR HOTTER. DANTE RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 03/17/2025) Page 2 of 3
